name: ipad-screen
description: Lets Claude see your iPad screen, mirrored to this Mac in QuickTime Player.
long_description: Adds one read-only tool, `view_ipad_screen`, that snapshots the QuickTime Player window showing your iPad (File › New Movie Recording, iPad as the camera). Runs only on this Mac: no network access, nothing written to disk. Needs Screen Recording permission for iPadScreen.

tools.name: view_ipad_screen
tools.description: Returns a current screenshot of the user's iPad screen, mirrored through QuickTime Player.
